note: Settings: one object standing in a place that suits the vibe, the object still the hero, large and readable, the place behind it in soft focus (Tys, 30 Oct: "the blank background really kills these ones ... maybe bigger objects?"). Each place is the phrase the prompt puts after the object ("One single scarab cast in solid polished gold, on wind-rippled sand dunes at dusk."), so it starts with its preposition. No people, no text, no signage, no second creature. A vibe without a list draws on the default list. Grown with `xenoform stills grow <vibe> --kind setting`, listed with kind: setting and the place on the row, and used by the Simple make body's backdrop choice (places).
